module mchp-velocitysp-port {
  yang-version 1.1;
  namespace "urn:mchp:params:xml:ns:yang:velocitysp-port";
  prefix lm-port;
  import ietf-yang-types {
    prefix yang;
  }
  import ietf-interfaces {
    prefix if;
  }
  import iana-if-type {
    prefix ianaif;
  }
  import ieee802-dot1q-types {
    prefix dot1qtypes;
  }
  import ieee802-ethernet-interface {
    prefix ieee802-eth-if;
  }
  description
    "This module contains a collection of YANG definitions for
     managing ports of MCHP systems running VelocitySP software.";

  revision 2026-06-30 {
    description
      "Added Port test feature.";
  }

  revision 2025-12-31 {
    description
      "Added PLCA configuration.
       Added Scheduler DWRR accounting mode";
  }

  revision 2025-09-30 {
    description
      "Added Traffic Class shaper mode. Shaping can be done based on data rate or line rate.";
  }

  revision 2025-06-30 {
    description
      "Added extended VID type and default values.";
  }

  revision 2025-01-20 {
    description
      "Added Port Policers.";
  }

  revision 2024-12-20 {
    description
      "Initial revision.";
  }

  typedef oper-info-type {
    type enumeration {
      enum oper_speed_default_based;     // Speed origins from default
      enum oper_speed_mgmt_based;        // Speed set by mgmt
      enum oper_speed_sfp_based;         // Speed set by sfp
      enum oper_speed_sfp_not_supported; // Illegal setup
    }
    description "Port speed origins/errors";
  }

  typedef phy-clock-role-type {
    type enumeration {
      enum phy_clock_auto;     // Auto mode
      enum phy_clock_leader;   // Formerly master
      enum phy_clock_follower; // Formerly slave
    }
    description "Clock roles of the phy";
  }

  typedef vid-ext {
    type uint16 {
      range "0 .. 4095";
    }
    description
      "Extended VLAN ID type.";
  }

  typedef shaper-mode {
    type enumeration {
      enum data {
        description
          "Shaping is done based on Data Rate, that is the rate of data in the switch
           without preamble and inter frame gap (20 bytes)";
      }
      enum line {
        description
          "Shaping is done based on Line Rate, that is the rate on the line including
           preamble and inter frame gap (20 bytes)";
      }
    }
    description
      "The mode of the shaper is indicating if shaping is done based on data rate or line rate";
  }

  typedef schedulers-mode {
    type enumeration {
      enum line {
        description
          "traffic-class-schedulers-bandwidth percentage is assigned based on Line Rate,
           that is the rate on the line including preamble and inter frame gap (20 bytes).";
      }
      enum frame {
        description
          "traffic-class-schedulers-bandwidth percentage is assigned based on Frame Rate.";
      }
    }
    description
      "The scheduler DWRR accounting mode. The bandwidth percentage is assigned based on Line rate or Frame rate";
  }

  typedef prbs-pattern {
    type enumeration {
      enum prbs7 {
        description
          "Serdes PRBS-7 patter is generated";
      }
      enum prbs15 {
        description
          "Serdes PRBS-15 patter is generated";
      }
      enum prbs23 {
        description
          "Serdes PRBS-23 patter is generated";
      }
      enum prbs31 {
        description
          "Serdes PRBS-31 patter is generated";
      }
    }
    
    description
      "The generated PRBS pattern";
  }

  typedef one-shot-test-mode {
    type enumeration {
      enum cable-diag {
        description
          "The port is isolated during the test, meaning frames are not forwarded to and from the port.
           The cable diagnostic test is executed.
           Result is in one-shot-test-result/cable-diag";
      }
      enum host-side-loop-frame {
        description
          "The port is isolated during the test, meaning frames are not forwarded to and from the port.
           The host side loop is created, meaning frames generated against the line is looped back to the host.
           Frames are generated at line speed for a pre-define time.
           The host side loop is removed.
           Result is in one-shot-test-result/host-side-loop-frame";
      }
      enum frame-gen {
        description
          "This mode is intended to be used as part of a Multi step test where a far end line side loop is created.
           Frames are generated against the line at line speed for a pre-define time.
           Result is in one-shot-test-result/frame-gen";
      }
      enum prbs-gen {
        description
          "This mode is intended to be used as part of a Multi step test where a far end line side loop is created.
           The PRBS pattern is generated against the line for a pre-define time.
           Result is in one-shot-test-result/prbs-gen";
      }
    }
  }

  typedef line-side-loop-position {
    type enumeration {
      enum loop-outer {
        description
          "The line side loop is done in the PHY. If there is no PHY the loop is done in the switch.
           This must be selected if the looped frames ingresses on the link";
      }
      enum loop-inner {
        description
          "The line side loop is done in the switch. Same as loop-outer if there is no PHY.
           This must be selected when doing prbs-phy-host test";
      }
    }
  }

  typedef test-cable-diag-status {
    type enumeration {
      enum ok {
        description
          "Correctly terminated pair";
      }
      enum open {
        description
          "Open pair";
      }
      enum short {
        description
          "Short pair";
      }
      enum abnorm {
        description
          "Abnormal termination";
      }
      enum short_a {
        description
          "Cross-pair short to pair A";
      }
      enum short_b {
        description
          "Cross-pair short to pair B";
      }
      enum short_c {
        description
          "Cross-pair short to pair C";
      }
      enum short_d {
        description
          "Cross-pair short to pair D";
      }
      enum coupl_a {
        description
          "Abnormal cross-pair coupling, pair A";
      }
      enum coupl_b {
        description
          "Abnormal cross-pair coupling, pair B";
      }
      enum coupl_c {
        description
          "Abnormal cross-pair coupling, pair C";
      }
      enum coupl_d {
        description
          "Abnormal cross-pair coupling, pair D";
      }
      enum unknown {
        description
          "Unknown - Cable Diagnostic never started ?";
      }
      enum running {
        description
          "VeriPhy is still running - No result yet";
      }
    }
    description
      "The Cable Diagnostic result status";
  }

  feature trunk_vlan {
    description
      "This feature is the configuration of pushing a tag to mirrored
       frames transmitted on the MONITOR port to support a trunk VLAN";
  }

  feature frame_selector {
    description
      "This feature is the configuration of port policing frame selector,
       the selection which frames are policed";
  }

  augment "/if:interfaces/if:interface" {
    when
      "if:type = 'ianaif:ethernetCsmacd'" {
      description
        "Applies when an Ethernet bridge port.";
    }
    description
      "Augment the interface model with the Ethernet bridge port";
    container eth-port {
      description
        "Ethernet port is an extension of the IETF Interfaces model (RFC7223).";
      container config {
        description
          "Container of configuration for each bridge port.";
        leaf max-frame-length {
          type uint16 {
            range "1518..10240";
          }
          default "10240";
          description
            "Maximum frame size accepted on the port, including FCS.";
        }
        leaf duplex {
          type ieee802-eth-if:duplex-type;
          description
            "Operational duplex mode of the Ethernet interface.";
        }
        leaf speed {
          type ieee802-eth-if:eth-if-speed-type;
          units "Gb/s";
          description
            "Administrative speed of the Ethernet interface.
             If ieee802-eth-if:auto-negotiation is enabled this field is ignored.
             If Fiber SFP is inserted this field is ignored.
             If DAC SFP is inserted this field is used.";
        }
        leaf phy-clock-role {
          type phy-clock-role-type;
          default "phy_clock_auto";
          description
            "Role of the phy clock Auto/Leader/Follower";
        }
        container plca {
          description
            "Physical Layer Collision Avoidance (PLCA) configuration.";
          leaf admin-state {
            type boolean;
            default "false";
            description
              "Administrative state of PLCA.";
            reference "IEEE-802.3-2022, 30.16.1.1.1, aPLCAAdminState";
          }
          leaf node-count {
            type uint8;
            default "8";
            description
              "Number of nodes getting a transmit opportunity.
               This parameter is only used if the node is coordinator.";
            reference "IEEE-802.3-2022, 30.16.1.1.3, aPLCANodeCount";
          }
          leaf node-id {
            type uint8;
            default "255";
            description
              "ID of node in PLCA network.
               - Value 0 means that the node is PLCA coordinator.
               - Value 1-254 mean that the node is PLCA follower.
               - Value 255 means that PLCA is disabled.";
            reference "IEEE-802.3-2022, 30.16.1.1.4, aPLCALocalNodeID";
          }
          leaf to-timer {
            type uint8 {
              range "1..255";
            }
            default "32";
            description
              "Transmit opportunity timer measured in bits.";
            reference "IEEE-802.3-2022, 30.16.1.1.5, aPLCATransmitOpportunityTimer";
          }
          leaf burst-max {
            type uint8;
            default "0";
            description
              "Maximum number of additional packets in a single transmit opportunity.";
            reference "IEEE-802.3-2022, 30.16.1.1.6, aPLCAMaxBurstCount";
          }
          leaf burst-timer {
            type uint8;
            default "128";
            description
              "Burst timer measured in bits.";
            reference "IEEE-802.3-2022, 30.16.1.1.7, aPLCABurstTimer";
          }
        }
      }
      container status {
        config false;
        description
          "Container of status for each bridge port.";
        leaf flow-control {
          type ieee802-eth-if:pause-fc-direction-type;
          description
            "Operational flow control mode of the Ethernet interface.";
        }
        leaf oper-info {
          type oper-info-type;
          description
            "Information of the operational status of the Ethernet interface.";
        }
      }
      container statistics {
        config false;
        description
          "Container of statistics for each bridge port.";
        action clear-statistics {
          description
            "Clear port counters.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819 extension";
        }
        leaf clear {
          status obsolete;
          type boolean;
          description
            "Clear port counters.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819 extension";
        }
        leaf rx-64-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received packets with a length of 64 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsPkts64Octets";
        }
        leaf rx-65-127-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received packets with a length of 65-127 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsPkts65to127Octets";
        }
        leaf rx-128-255-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received packets with a length of 128-255 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsPkts128to255Octets";
        }
        leaf rx-256-511-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received packets with a length of 256-511 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsPkts256to511Octets";
        }
        leaf rx-512-1023-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received packets with a length of 512-1023 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsPkts512to1023Octets";
        }
        leaf rx-1024-1518-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received packets with a length of 1024-1518 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsPkts1024to1518Octets";
        }
        leaf rx-1519-max-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received packets with a length greater than 1518 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819 extension";
        }
        leaf rx-fragments {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received fragment packets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsFragments";
        }
        leaf rx-jabbers {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received jabber packets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Rx etherStatsJabbers";
        }
        leaf tx-64-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted packets with a length of 64 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Tx etherStatsPkts64Octets";
        }
        leaf tx-65-127-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted packets with a length of 65-127 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Tx etherStatsPkts65to127Octets";
        }
        leaf tx-128-255-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted packets with a length of 128-255 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Tx etherStatsPkts128to255Octets";
        }
        leaf tx-256-511-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted packets with a length of 256-511 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Tx etherStatsPkts256to511Octets";
        }
        leaf tx-512-1023-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted packets with a length of 512-1023 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Tx etherStatsPkts512to1023Octets";
        }
        leaf tx-1024-1518-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted packets with a length of 1024-1518 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819: Tx etherStatsPkts1024to1518Octets";
        }
        leaf tx-1519-max-octets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted packets with a length greater than 1518 octets.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819 extension";
        }
        list traffic-class {
          key "traffic-class";
          description
            "The counters for a traffic class.";
          reference
            "RFC 2819 extension";
          leaf traffic-class {
            type dot1qtypes:traffic-class-type;
            description
              "The traffic class index.";
            reference
              "8.6.6 of IEEE Std 802.1Q-2018";
          }
          leaf rx-packets {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of received packets for a given traffic class.";
            reference
              "RFC 2819 extension";
          }
          leaf tx-packets {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of transmitted packets for a given traffic class.";
            reference
              "RFC 2819 extension";
          }
        }
        leaf rx-mm-fragments {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received mPackets.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.3br-2016: aMACMergeFragCountRx";
        }
        leaf rx-mm-asm-packets {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received successfully reassembled packets.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.3br-2016: aMACMergeFrameAssOkCount";
        }
        leaf rx-mm-asm-errors {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of reassembly errors.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.3br-2016: aMACMergeFrameAssErrorCount";
        }
        leaf rx-mm-smd-errors {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of received frames with SMD errors.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.3br-2016: aMACMergeFrameSmdErrorCount";
        }
        leaf tx-mm-fragments {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of transmitted mPackets.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.3br-2016: aMACMergeFragCountTx";
        }
        leaf tx-mm-holds {
          type yang:counter64;
          description
            "The number of hold transitions.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.3br-2016: aMACMergeHoldCount";
        }
      }
      container test {
        description
          "Container of test and diagnostic features for each bridge port.";
        leaf sqi-value {
          config false;
          type uint8;
          description
            "The Signal Quality Indicator value. It is in the range is 0 to 7 or 255.
             The value 0 is worst quality and value 7 is best quality.
             The value is 255 if this is not supported";
        }
        container one-shot-test {
          action activate {
            description
              "The one shot test is activated and run autonomously for a defined time.
               When completed, test results will be available in one-shot-test-result";
          
            input {
              leaf mode {
                mandatory true;
                type one-shot-test-mode;
                description
                  "The one shot test mode to activated.
                   For details about the tests, read description of the one-shot-test-mode type";
              }
              leaf pattern {
                default prbs31;
                type prbs-pattern;
                description
                  "The one shot prbs-gen test pattern to generate.";
              }
            }
          }
          choice result {
            description
              "The one shot test results.";
            config false;
            container cable-diag {
              description
                "Containing cable-diag one shot test results.";
              leaf link {
                type boolean;
                default false;
                description
                  "The Link status";
              }
              list pair-result {
                key "index";
                description
                  "The Diagnostic result for each cable pair A-D.
                   pair-index is 1-4";
                leaf index {
                    type uint8 {
                    range "1..4";
                    }
                    description
                    "The index of the cable pair result.";
                }
                leaf status {
                  type test-cable-diag-status;
                  description
                    "The cable pair Diagnostic status.
                     unknown means - no test has been started.
                     running means - started test is not completed.";
                }
                leaf length {
                  type uint16;
                  description
                      "The cable pair length in meters.";
                }
              }
            }
            container host-side-loop-frame {
              description
                "Containing host-side-loop-frame one shot test results.";
              leaf tx-frame-count {
                type uint64;
                description
                  "The number of transmitted frames during generator active.
                   The counter is cleared when frame generator is activated.";
              }
              leaf rx-frame-count {
                type uint64;
                description
                  "The number of received frames during generator active.
                   The counter is cleared when frame generator is activated.";
              }
            }
            container frame-gen {
              description
                "Containing frame-gen one shot test results.";
              leaf tx-frame-count {
                type uint64;
                description
                  "The number of transmitted frames during generator active.
                   The counter is cleared when frame generator is activated.";
              }
              leaf rx-frame-count {
                type uint64;
                description
                  "The number of received frames during generator active.
                   The counter is cleared when frame generator is activated.";
              }
            }
            container prbs-gen {
              description
                "Containing prbs-gen one shot test results.";
              leaf error-count {
                type uint32;
                description
                  "The PRBS error count";
              }
            }
          }
        }
        container multi-step-test {
          description
            "Containing actions required to do multi step test.
             * The line side loop one-shot frame test scenario:
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/isolate(true)
                Far end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(true, loop-outer)
                Near end:
                    one-shot-test(frame-gen)
                    Fetch one-shot-test-result/frame_gen
                Far end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(false)
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/isolate(false)
             * The line side loop one-shot PRBS test scenario:
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/isolate(true)
                Far end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(true, loop-outer)
                Near end:
                    one-shot-test(prbs-gen)
                    Fetch one-shot-test-result/prbs_gen
                Far end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(false)
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/isolate(false)
             * The line side loop contiguous switch PRBS test scenario:
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/isolate(true)
                Far end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(true, loop-outer)
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-switch(true)
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-switch(false)
                    Fetch multi-step-test/result/prbs-switch-error-count
                Far end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(false)
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/isolate(false)
             * The line side loop contiguous PHY host to switch PRBS test scenario:
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(true, loop-inner)
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-phy-host(true)
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-phy-host(false)
                    multi-step-test-actions/line-side-loop(false)
                    Fetch multi-step-test/result/prbs-phy-host-error-count
             * The bidirectional contiguous switch to switch PRBS test scenario:
                Far end + Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-switch(true)
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-switch(false)
                    Fetch multi-step-test/result/prbs-switch-error-count
             * The bidirectional contiguous switch to PHY host PRBS test scenario:
                Near end:
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-switch(true)
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-phy-host(true)
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-switch(false)
                    multi-step-test-actions/prbs-phy-host(false)
                    Fetch multi-step-test/result/prbs-switch-error-count
                    Fetch multi-step-test/result/prbs-phy-host-error-count";
          container actions {
            action isolate {
              description
                "When port is isolated, frames are not forwarded to and from the port.";
              input {
                leaf active {
                  mandatory true;
                  type boolean;
                  description
                    "True means the port is isolated";
                }
              }
            }
            action line-side-loop {
              description
                "A line side loop is looping frames/prbs received on the line back to the line";
              input {
                leaf active {
                  mandatory true;
                  type boolean;
                  description
                    "True:
                     The port is isolated, meaning frames are not forwarded to and from the port.
                     The line side loop is created.
                     False:
                     The port is no more isolated and the line side loop is removed.";
                }
                leaf position {
                  default loop-outer;
                  type line-side-loop-position;
                  description
                    "The position of the line side loop is either loop-outer or loop-inner";
                }
              }
            }
            action host-side-loop {
              description
                "A host side loop is looping frames transmitted on the line back to the host";
              input {
                leaf active {
                  mandatory true;
                  type boolean;
                  description
                    "True:
                     The port is isolated, meaning frames are not forwarded to and from the port.
                     The host side loop is created.
                     False:
                     The port is no more isolated and the host side loop is removed.";
                }
              }
            }
            action prbs-phy-host {
              description
                "The PHY host side PRBS pattern generator and/or monitor can be active or passive";
              input {
                leaf active {
                  mandatory true;
                  type boolean;
                  description
                    "True:
                     The port is isolated, meaning frames are not forwarded to and from the port.
                     The contiguous PHY host PRBS pattern generator is active generating the selected pattern.
                     The PHY host PRBS monitor is active monitoring the selected pattern";
                }
                leaf pattern {
                  default prbs31;
                  type prbs-pattern;
                  description
                    "The PHY host PRBS test pattern to generate/monitor.";
                }
              }
            }
            action prbs-switch {
              description
                "The switch PRBS pattern generator and/or monitor can be active or passive";
              input {
                leaf active {
                  mandatory true;
                  type boolean;
                  description
                    "True:
                     The port is isolated, meaning frames are not forwarded to and from the port.
                     The contiguous switch PRBS pattern generator is active generating the selected pattern.
                     The switch PRBS monitor is active monitoring the selected pattern";
                }
                leaf pattern {
                  default prbs31;
                  type prbs-pattern;
                  description
                    "The switch PRBS test pattern to generate/monitor.";
                }
              }
            }
            action prbs-phy-host-error {
              description
                "The PHY PRBS pattern error generator can be active or passive";
              input {
                leaf active {
                  mandatory true;
                  type boolean;
                  description
                    "True: PRBS errors will be introduced over time.";
                }
              }
            }
            action prbs-switch-error {
              description
                "The switch PRBS pattern error generator can be active or passive";
              input {
                leaf active {
                  mandatory true;
                  type boolean;
                  description
                    "True: PRBS errors will be introduced over time.";
                }
              }
            }
          }
          container status {
            config false;
            description
              "The status of multi step test actions";
            leaf isolate {
              type boolean;
              description
                "True means the port is isolated";
            }
            leaf line-side-loop {
              type boolean;
              description
                "True means the line side loop is created";
            }
            leaf line-side-loop-position {
              type line-side-loop-position;
              description
                "The line side loop position (Outer or Inner)";
            }
            leaf host-side-loop {
              type boolean;
              description
                "True means the loop is created";
            }
            leaf prbs-switch {
              type boolean;
              description
                "True means the contiguous switch PRBS generator/monitor is active";
            }
            leaf prbs-switch-pattern {
              type prbs-pattern;
              description
                "The switch PRBS test pattern.";
            }
            leaf prbs-phy-host {
              type boolean;
              description
                "True means the contiguous PHY host PRBS generator/monitor is active";
            }
            leaf prbs-phy-host-pattern {
              type prbs-pattern;
              description
                "The PHY host PRBS test pattern.";
            }
          }
          container result {
            description
              "The multi test results.";
            config false;
            leaf prbs-switch-error-count {
              type uint32;
              description
                "The switch PRBS error count";
            }
            leaf prbs-phy-host-error-count {
              type uint32;
              description
                "The PHY host PRBS error count";
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    container eth-qos {
      description
        "Ethernet QOS is an extension of the IETF Interfaces model (RFC7223).";
      container config {
        description
          "Container of QOS configuration for each bridge port.";
        list traffic-class-shapers {
          key "traffic-class";
          description
            "This map associate the traffic-class
            parameter to the traffic-class shaper configuration";
          leaf traffic-class {
            type dot1qtypes:traffic-class-type;
            description
              "The traffic class index associated with a given traffic
              class.";
            reference
              "8.6.6 of IEEE Std 802.1Q-2018";
          }
          choice type {
            description
              "The shaper type";
            container single-leaky-bucket {
              description
                  "Container of the Single Leaky Bucket shaper configuration";
              leaf committed-information-rate {
                type uint32 {
                    range "0..4294967295";
                }
                description
                  "The Committed information rate in kilobits per second.
                   The rate will be rounded to the nearest value supported";

              }
              leaf committed-burst-size {
                type uint32 {
                    range "0..4294967295";
                }
                description
                  "The Committed Burst Size in bytes.
                   The size will be rounded to the nearest value supported";
              }
              leaf mode {
                type shaper-mode;
                default "data";
                description
                  "The committed information rate can be either data or line rate";
              }
            }
            container credit-based {
              description
                  "Container of the Credit based shaper configuration";
              leaf idle-slope {
                type uint32 {
                    range "0..4294967295";
                }
                description
                  "The Idle slope is the rate of credits that is accumulated
                  (in kilobits per second)";
                reference
                  "8.6.8.2 of IEEE Std 802.1Q-2018";
              }
              leaf mode {
                type shaper-mode;
                default "data";
                description
                  "The rate of credits can be either data or line rate";
              }
            }
          }
        }
        leaf traffic-class-schedulers-mode {
          type schedulers-mode;
          default "line";
          description
            "The scheduler DWRR accounting mode can be either line rate or frame rate";
        }
        leaf-list traffic-class-schedulers-bandwidth {
          type uint8 {
              range "0..100";
          }
          description
              "This list contains the traffic-class scheduler bandwidth in percent.
              The list only contains traffic-class that is part of Weighted Fairness queueing (DWRR).
              The first traffic-class in the list is 0, the next is always one higher.
              The traffic-class not in the list is strict scheduling.";
        }
        list port-policers {
          key "index";
          description
            "Multiple policers can be created on the same port.
             The maximum number of policers is hardware dependent.
             Which frames to be policed can be selected by 'frame_selector'.
             In case a frame is selected by multiple polices the most conservative wins";
          leaf index {
            type uint8 {
              range "1..max";
            }
            description
              "The index of the port policer.";
          }

          leaf frame-selector {
            if-feature frame_selector;
            type bits {
              bit known-unicast {
                position 0;
                description
                  "Police known unicast frames.";
              }
              bit known-multicast {
                position 1;
                description
                  "Police known multicast frames.";
              }
              bit known-broadcast {
                position 2;
                description
                  "Police known broadcast frames.";
              }
              bit unknown-unicast {
                position 3;
                description
                  "Police unknown unicast frames.";
              }
              bit unknown-multicast {
                position 4;
                description
                  "Police unknown multicast frames.";
              }
              bit unknown-broadcast {
                position 5;
                description
                  "Police unknown broadcast frames.";
              }
            }
            description
              "Selection of which frames are policed.
               All ingress frames on the port are policed if all are selected.
               Default is all bit set and on some platforms it cannot be changed.";
          }
          choice type {
            description
              "The policer can be either a type frame or bit rate policer.";
            container frame-rate {
              description
                "Container of the frame rate policer.";
              leaf rate {
                type uint32;
                description
                  "Frame rate (frames per second).";
              }
              leaf burst-size {
                type uint32;
                description
                  "Burst size (Bytes).";
              }
            }
            container bit-rate {
              description
                "Container of the bit rate policer.";
              leaf rate {
                type uint64;
                description
                  "Bit rate (bits per second).";
              }
              leaf burst-size {
                type uint32;
                description
                  "Burst size (Bytes).";
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    container eth-mirror {
      presence
        "Configures this ports role in the mirroring functionality. If not precent,
         the role of this ports is NONE";
      description
        "Ethernet MIRROR is an extension of the IETF Interfaces model (RFC7223).
         This is supporting configuration of copying frames to a monitor port";
      container config {
        description
          "Container of MIRROR configuration for each bridge port.
           It is implemented as a choice with a container for each role the port can have
           in the Mirroring functionality.
           Configuring a (role) case container changes the current role of the port.
           Getting this (config) container will only return the case container of the current role.
           Getting a case container of a not current role will return NOT FOUND";
        choice role {
          description
            "The interface mirror role configuration.";
          container monitor {
            description
              "This is the MONITOR role configuration. Frames forwarded from the Mirrored interfaces are transmitted on this port.
               Only one port can have this role";
            leaf forwarding {
              type boolean;
              description
                "Enable normal traffic forwarding to Monitor role interface";
            }
            leaf vid {
                if-feature trunk_vlan;
                type vid-ext;
                description
                  "The VLAN identifier used in a pushed TAG on transmitted
                   mirrored frames to support a trunk VLAN. A VLAN tag is only pushed if
                   value is not zero. The tag type is C-TAG unless the port-type is provider-network-port,
                   then it is S-TAG";
            }
          }
          container mirrored {
            description
              "This is the MIRRORED role configuration. Ingress and/or egress frames on this interface is
               forwarded to the MONITOR role interface. Multiple ports can have this role";
            leaf ingress {
              type boolean;
              description
                "Enable ingress frames to be forwarded to MONITOR role interface";
            }
            leaf egress {
              type boolean;
              description
                "Enable egress frames to be forwarded to MONITOR role interface";
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

module mchp-velocitysp-aggr {
  yang-version 1.1;
  namespace "urn:mchp:params:xml:ns:yang:velocitysp-aggr";
  prefix lm-aggr;
  import ietf-yang-types {
    prefix "yang";
  }
  import ieee802-types {
    prefix "ieee";
  }
  import ietf-interfaces {
    prefix if;
  }
  import iana-if-type {
    prefix ianaif;
  }
  description
    "This module contains a collection of YANG definitions for managing
     link aggregations of MCHP systems running VelocitySP software.";

  revision 2025-06-30 {
    description
      "Added default values.";
  }

  revision 2023-10-19 {
    description
      "Initial revision.";
  }

  container aggr-system {
    description
      "Link aggregation system information.";
    container config {
      description
        "Container of configuration for the system.";
      leaf system-priority {
        type uint16;
        default "32768";
        description
          "The priority of the aggregating system.";
        reference
          "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.2";
      }
    }
  }

  augment "/if:interfaces/if:interface" {
    when
      "if:type = 'ianaif:ethernetCsmacd'" {
      description
        "Applies when an Ethernet bridge port.";
    }
    description
      "Augment the interface model with the Ethernet bridge port";
    container aggr-port {
      description
        "Ethernet port extension of the IETF Interfaces model (RFC7223).";
      container config {
        description
          "Container of configuration for each bridge port.";
        leaf group {
          type uint16;
          default "0";
          description
            "Aggregator group number. The first group has number zero.
             For a system with N ports, N/2 groups are supported.";
        }
        leaf mode {
          type enumeration {
            enum disabled {
              description
                "Link aggregation is disabled.";
            }
            enum enabled {
              description
                "Link aggregation is statically enabled.";
            }
            enum lacp-active {
              description
                "LACP is enabled in active mode.";
            }
            enum lacp-passive {
              description
                "LACP is enabled in passive mode.";
            }
          }
          default "disabled";
          description
            "Aggregation mode for port.";
        }
        leaf lacp-timeout {
          type enumeration {
            enum slow {
              description
                "Timeout is 30 seconds.";
            }
            enum fast {
              description
                "Timeout is 1 second.";
            }
          }
          default "fast";
          description
            "LACP timeout for port.";
        }
        leaf port-priority {
          type uint16;
          default "32768";
          description
            "The priority value assigned to this port.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.15";
        }
      }
      container status {
        config false;
        description
          "Container of status for each bridge port.";
        leaf actor-system-priority {
          type uint16;
          description
            "Operational value of system priority.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.2";
        }
        leaf actor-system-mac {
          type ieee:mac-address;
          description
            "Operational value of actor system MAC address.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.3";
        }
        leaf actor-key {
          type uint16;
          description
            "Operational value of the actor key.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.5";
        }
        leaf actor-port-priority {
          type uint16;
          description
            "Operational value of the actor port priority.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.15";
        }
        leaf actor-port {
          type uint16;
          description
            "The actor port number locally assigned.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.14";
        }
        leaf actor-state {
          type bits {
            bit lacp-activity {
              position 0;
              description
                "LACP activity actor state.";
            }
            bit lacp-timeout {
              position 1;
              description
                "LACP timeout actor state.";
            }
            bit aggregation {
              position 2;
              description
                "Aggregation actor state.";
            }
            bit synchronization {
              position 3;
              description
                "Synchronization actor state.";
            }
            bit collecting {
              position 4;
              description
                "Collecting actor state.";
            }
            bit distributing {
              position 5;
              description
                "Distributing actor state.";
            }
            bit defaulted {
              position 6;
              description
                "Defaulted actor state.";
            }
            bit expired {
              position 7;
              description
                "Expired actor state.";
            }
          }
          description
            "Operational value of actor state.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.21";
        }
        leaf partner-system-priority {
          type uint16;
          description
            "Operational value of system priority.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.7";
        }
        leaf partner-system-mac {
          type ieee:mac-address;
          description
            "Operational value of partner system MAC address.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.8";
        }
        leaf partner-key {
          type uint16;
          description
            "Operational value of the partner key.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.11";
        }
        leaf partner-port-priority {
          type uint16;
          description
            "Operational value of the partner port priority.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.19";
        }
        leaf partner-port {
          type uint16;
          description
            "The partner port number locally assigned.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.17";
        }
        leaf partner-state {
          type bits {
            bit lacp-activity {
              position 0;
              description
                "LACP activity partner state.";
            }
            bit lacp-timeout {
              position 1;
              description
                "LACP timeout partner state.";
            }
            bit aggregation {
              position 2;
              description
                "Aggregation partner state.";
            }
            bit synchronization {
              position 3;
              description
                "Synchronization partner state.";
            }
            bit collecting {
              position 4;
              description
                "Collecting partner state.";
            }
            bit distributing {
              position 5;
              description
                "Distributing partner state.";
            }
            bit defaulted {
              position 6;
              description
                "Defaulted partner state.";
            }
            bit expired {
              position 7;
              description
                "Expired partner state.";
            }
          }
          description
            "Operational value of partner state.";
          reference
            "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.2.1.23";
        }
        leaf aggr-name {
          type string;
          description
            "Operational aggregation interface name ('NONE' if not aggregated).";
        }
      }
      container statistics {
        config false;
        description
          "Container of protocol statistics for each bridge port.";
          leaf rx-lacp-pdu {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of received valid LACPDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.2";
          }
          leaf rx-marker-pdu {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of received valid Marker PDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.3";
          }
          leaf rx-marker-response-pdu {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of received valid Marker Response PDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.4";
          }
          leaf rx-unknown {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of frames received unknown PDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.5";
          }
          leaf rx-illegal {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of frames received badly formed PDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.6";
          }
          leaf tx-lacp-pdu {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of transmitted LACPDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.7";
          }
          leaf tx-marker-pdu {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of transmitted Marker PDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.8";
          }
          leaf tx-marker-response-pdu {
            type yang:counter64;
            description
              "The number of transmitted Marker Response PDUs.";
            reference
              "IEEE 802.1AX-2014, Clause 7.3.3.1.9";
          }
      }
    }
  }

  augment "/if:interfaces/if:interface" {
    when "if:type = 'ianaif:ieee8023adLag'" {
      description
        "Applies when an Ethernet bridge port aggregator.";
      }
    description
      "Augment the interface model with the Ethernet bridge port aggregator.";
    container aggregator {
      description
        "Ethernet aggregator extension of the IETF Interfaces model (RFC7223).";
      container config {
        description
          "Container of configuration for each aggregator.";
        leaf max-bundle {
          type uint16;
          default "0";
          description
            "The maximum number of active ports in an aggregator.
             When the limit is reached, low priority ports will become standby.
             The value zero means that no administrative limit is setup.";
        }
        leaf failover-mode {
          type enumeration {
            enum revertive {
              description
                "When a higher priority port comes back up it will become active.";
            }
            enum non-revertive {
              description
                "When a higher priority port comes back up it will become standby.";
            }
          }
          default "revertive";
          description
            "Failover mode for aggregator. If a higher priority port goes down,
            lower priority ports will become active. If the higher priority port
            comes back up, the failover mode determines whether it becomes active.";
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

module mchp-velocitysp-acl {
  yang-version 1.1;
  namespace "urn:mchp:params:xml:ns:yang:velocitysp-acl";
  prefix lm-acl;
  import ieee802-types {
    prefix "ieee";
  }
  import ietf-interfaces {
    prefix if;
  }
  import ietf-inet-types {
    prefix inet;
  }
  import iana-if-type {
    prefix ianaif;
  }
  description
    "This module contains a collection of YANG definitions for managing
     ACL filtering of MCHP systems running VelocitySP software.";

  revision 2025-06-30 {
    description
      "Added default values.";
  }

  revision 2025-03-31 {
    description
      "Initial revision.";
  }

  typedef acl-bit-type {
    type enumeration {
      enum any {
        description
          "Any value (0 or 1) matches.";
      }
      enum one {
        description
          "Value 1 matches.";
      }
      enum zero {
        description
          "Value 0 matches.";
      }
    }
    description
      "Type used for matching of a single bit of the frame.";
  }

  typedef acl-forwarding-type {
    type enumeration {
      enum none {
        description
          "No frame forwarding change.";
      }
      enum filter {
        description
          "Frame filtering using egress port list.";
      }
      enum redirect {
        description
          "Frame redirect using egress port list.";
      }
    }
    description
      "Type used for the forwarding action for the frame.";
  }

  grouping acl-parameters {
    description
      "ACL action parameters for an ACL rule or ingress port.";
    leaf forwarding {
      type acl-forwarding-type;
      default "none";
      description
        "The forwarding action for the frame.";
    }
    leaf-list egress-port-list {
      type if:interface-ref;
      description
        "The list of egress ports when filtering is enabled.";
    }
    leaf policer-enable {
      type boolean;
      default "false";
      description
        "Control whether policer is enabled.";
    }
    leaf policer-index {
      type uint8;
      default "0";
      description
        "Policer index.";
    }
    leaf rx-count {
      type uint32;
      config false;
      description
        "Frame match counter.";
    }
    action clear {
      description
        "Clear match counter.";
    }
  }

  grouping acl-ip-parameters {
    description
      "ACL IPv4/IPv6 parameters.";
    leaf ttl {
      type acl-bit-type;
      description
        "The IP TTL property of the rule.
         This can be used to match frames with TTL greater than zero.";
    }
    leaf proto {
      type uint8;
      description
        "The IP protocol value of the rule.";
    }
    leaf proto-mask {
      type uint8;
      description
        "The IP protocol mask of the rule.";
    }
    leaf ds {
      type uint8;
      description
        "The IP DS value of the rule.";
    }
    leaf ds-mask {
      type uint8;
      description
        "The IP DS mask of the rule.";
    }
    leaf data {
      type uint32;
      description
        "The IP data (not UDP/TCP) of the rule.";
    }
    leaf data-mask {
      type uint32;
      description
        "The IP data mask (not UDP/TCP) of the rule.";
    }
    leaf sport-min {
      type uint16;
      description
        "The IP minimum UDP/TCP source port of the rule.";
    }
    leaf sport-max {
      type uint16;
      description
        "The IP minimum UDP/TCP source port of the rule.";
    }
    leaf dport-min {
      type uint16;
      description
        "The IP minimum UDP/TCP destination port of the rule.";
    }
    leaf dport-max {
      type uint16;
      description
        "The IP minimum UDP/TCP destination port of the rule.";
    }
    leaf tcp-fin {
      type acl-bit-type;
      description
        "The TCP FIN property of the rule.";
    }
    leaf tcp-syn {
      type acl-bit-type;
      description
        "The TCP SYN property of the rule.";
    }
    leaf tcp-rst {
      type acl-bit-type;
      description
        "The TCP RST property of the rule.";
    }
    leaf tcp-psh {
      type acl-bit-type;
      description
        "The TCP PSH property of the rule.";
    }
    leaf tcp-ack {
      type acl-bit-type;
      description
        "The TCP ACK property of the rule.";
    }
    leaf tcp-urg {
      type acl-bit-type;
      description
        "The TCP URG property of the rule.";
    }
  }

  container acl {
    description
      "Access Control List information.";

    status obsolete;

    container acl-rules {
      description
        "ACL rules information.";
      list rule-list {
        key "id";
        description
          "The Access Control List consists of an ordered set of rules.
           The first matching rule determines the action for an ingress frames.";
        leaf id {
          type uint16;
          description
            "The non-zero ID is used for ordering the ACL rules.
             Rules with lower IDs have higher priority in the ordering";
        }
        leaf-list ingress-port-list {
          type if:interface-ref;
          description
            "The list of ingress ports of the rule.";
        }
        leaf dmac {
          type ieee:mac-address;
          description
            "The DMAC value of the rule.";
        }
        leaf dmac-mask {
          type ieee:mac-address;
          description
            "The DMAC mask of the rule.";
        }
        leaf smac {
          type ieee:mac-address;
          description
            "The SMAC value of the rule.";
        }
        leaf smac-mask {
          type ieee:mac-address;
          description
            "The SMAC mask of the rule.";
        }
        leaf tagged {
          type acl-bit-type;
          description
            "The tag property of the rule.";
        }
        leaf vid {
          type uint16;
          description
            "The classified VLAN ID value of the rule.";
        }
        leaf vid-mask {
          type uint16;
          description
            "The VLAN ID mask of the rule.";
        }
        leaf pcp {
          type uint8;
          description
            "The classified PCP value of the rule.";
        }
        leaf pcp-mask {
          type uint8;
          description
            "The PCP mask of the rule.";
        }
        leaf dei {
         type acl-bit-type;
          description
            "The DEI property of the rule.";
        }
        choice parameters {
          description
            "Frame type specific parameters.";
          container frame-any {
            description
              "Any frame type matching.";
            leaf any {
              type empty;
              description
                "The presence of this leaf indicates matching of all frame types.";
            }
          }
          container frame-etype {
            description
              "Ethernet Type (not IPv4/IPv6) specific parameters.";
            leaf etype {
              type uint16;
               description
                "The Ethernet Type value of the rule.";
            }
            leaf etype-mask {
            type uint16;
            description
             "The Ethernet Type mask of the rule.";
            }
            leaf data {
              type uint16;
              description
                "The IP data (not UDP/TCP) of the rule.";
            }
            leaf data-mask {
              type uint16;
              description
                "The IP data mask (not UDP/TCP) of the rule.";
            }
          }
          container frame-ipv4 {
            description
              "IPv4 specific parameters.";
            leaf fragment {
              type acl-bit-type;
              description
                "The IPv4 fragment property of the rule.
                 This can be used to match IPv4 fragments.";
            }
            leaf options {
              type acl-bit-type;
              description
                "The IPv4 options property of the rule.
                 This can be used to match IPv4 frames with header length greater than 20 bytes";
            }
            leaf sip {
              type inet:ipv4-prefix;
              description
                "The IPv4 source address prefix of the rule.";
            }
            leaf dip {
              type inet:ipv4-prefix;
              description
                "The IPv4 destination address prefix of the rule.";
            }
            uses acl-ip-parameters;  
          }
          container frame-ipv6 {
            description
              "IPv6 specific parameters.";
            leaf sip {
              type inet:ipv6-prefix;
              description
                "The IPv6 source address prefix of the rule.";
            }
            leaf dip {
              type inet:ipv6-prefix;
              description
                "The IPv6 destination address prefix of the rule.";
            }
            uses acl-ip-parameters;  
          }
        }
        uses acl-parameters;  
      }
    }

    container acl-policers {
      description
        "ACL policer information.";
      list policer-list {
        key "index";
        description
          "The ACL policers can be referred to from an ACL rule or an ingress port.";
        leaf index {
          type uint8;
          description
            "The index of the ACL policer.";
        }
        choice rate {
          leaf frame-rate {
            type uint32;
            description
              "Frame rate (frames per second).";
          }
          leaf bit-rate {
            type uint64;
            description
              "Bit rate (bits per second).";
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  augment "/if:interfaces/if:interface" {
    when
      "if:type = 'ianaif:ethernetCsmacd'" {
      description
        "Applies when an Ethernet bridge port.";
    }
    description
      "Augment the interface model with the Ethernet bridge port";
    container acl-port {
      description
        "ACL port extension of the IETF Interfaces model (RFC7223).";

      status obsolete;

      uses acl-parameters;  
    }
  }
}
